::: {#def-automaton-language}
#### Language of an automaton

The **language** of a DFA $M = (S, \Sigma, \delta, s_0, F)$ (@def-dfa) [@wikipedia_deterministic_finite_automaton]
is the language (@def-formal-language)

$$
L(M) = \set{w \in \Sigma^* : M \text{ accepts } w}
$$

of the strings that $M$ accepts (@def-accept).

:::
